definition: a farm building for storing grain or animals
description: Inside a long barn with grey metal stalls down both sides of a concrete aisle, a toddler in jeans and a cream jumper toddles up to a wooden crate full of carrots and pulls one out. He carries it down the aisle, holding it up in the air, to where a black horse has its head out over a stall door. The horse stretches down and takes the carrot from his hand, and the little boy claps his hands and laughs.
transcript: Give it to Verspy. Good job, buddy.
